title: Agent Fox Mulder
gameEffect: [RP]s generated by Agent Mulder must be used to purchase cards. Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to play a Site for zero [RP] cost.
bio: While on probation from the FBI, Mulder continue his search for the truth. The demise of the Syndicate affords Mulder the opportunity to resume his work on the X - Files, until a mysterious artifact from a spaceship triggers the dormant alien virus in his body.

title: Agent Dana Scully
gameEffect: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to examine any one Bluff card. Place Bluff card back on Site after examining.
bio: After having been reassigned to the FBI Domestic Terrorism Unit, Scully continues to support Mulder's quest for the truth. Their journey brings her to the African coast where the discovery of a mysterious craft leads Scully to question the origins of mankind.

title: Mulder's Apartment
gameEffect: Play this card in your Bureau. During your Briefing Phase, you may place Agent Mulder under this card. Mulder is taken out of play for the rest of the turn.At the start of your next Briefing Phase, return Mulder to the Bureau and choose one of the following effects: increase any one of Mulder's skills by one for the remainder of the turn, or use one of his game effect tokens to pay for any one [RP] card this turn. The effects of this card may not be negated.
dialogue: "Got to have someplace to lounge around and read the Sunday New York Times." - Morris Fletcher (as Mulder)

title: Area 51
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File along with three tokens. Once per turn, you may remove a token to gain one of the following effects: play one GOVERNMENT card for 2 [CP] less, search your Bureau Deck and add any one GOVERNMENT card to your hand, or preemptively prevent your opponent from negating one GOVERNMENT card. Each effect may only be used once. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue: "Groom Lake. Area 51." - Mulder

title: Morris Fletcher
gameEffect: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token at any time during the game to add 2 [CP] to your pool immediately. This may only be done once per turn.
bio: As an operative for the Majestic Project, Morris Fletcher was in charge of keeping Area 51's experiments out of the press. Due to a space - time warp, Fletcher temporarily switched bodies with Agent Mulder ("Dreamland"). He later crossed paths with Agent Scully in Las Vegas, though the two were unaware of their prior encounter. ("Three of a Kind").

title: Deputy Arky Stevens
gameEffect: Add one [RP] to your pool every time a Team containing Deputy Stevens successfully investigates a Site with CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION as a prerequisite.
bio: Deputy Arky Stevens of Hollins, Virginia, reached out to the X - Files office to investigate the disappearance of his sister's unborn child. While Agent Spender refused to assist him, Agent Mulder was all too eager to help Stevens make sense of the strange happenings in his town.

title: Agent Peyton Ritter
gameEffect: If Ritter is on the same Team as Agent Scully, he gains +1 to his EVIDENCE COLLECTION and OBSERVATION skills. Once per game, when Ritter's Team is attacked by an Adversary, your opponent may pay 2 [CP] to deal Ritter's LRC damage to another Agent on his Team (opponent's choice). If Scully is on the Team, she must receive the damage.
bio: Agent Peyton Ritter was assigned to the New York City Field Office. Despite his cooperative disposition, his eagerness to apprehend murder suspect Alfred Fellig resulted in the accidental shooting of Agent Scully.

title: Agent Jeffrey Spender
gameEffect: If Spender is in the same Team as another NEUTRAL Agent, he gains +1 to his ALIEN INVESTIGATION and SUBTERFUGE skills. Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token at any time during the game to subtract 2 from an opponent's [RP] or [CP] Pool. This may only by done once per turn.
bio: Agent Jeffrey Spender's meteoric rise in the FBI was, unbeknownst to him, due to the influential patronage of his father, the Cigarette - Smoking Man. In spite of his hard - nosed skepticism, Spender was briefly partnered with Diana Fowley when the X - Files unit was reopened in 1998.

title: Agent Diana Fowley
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token at any time during the game to discard any one [RP] or [*P] card from your hand and add its cost to your [[Conspiracy]] Pool. This may only be done once per turn.
bio: Agent Diana Fowley was assigned to the X - Files after Agents Mulder and Scully were put on probation. Fowley had been Mulder's partner, both professionally and romantically, when he discovered the X - Files in 1991. Although she appeared loyal to Mulder, Fowley was actually working for the Cigarette - Smoking Man.

title: Arthur Dales, Retired FBI Agent
gameEffect: Place a token on this card. When Dales' Team successfully investigates a Keyword SCIENCES or SUBTERFUGE Site, you may discard a token to force your opponent to discard any one [CP] card in play in their section of the table.
bio: In 1952, Arthur Dales met Bill Mulder while working on the case of suspected communist spy Edward Skur. He later became the first FBI agent to investigate the X - Files ("Travelers"). After retiring, Dales moved to Florida and requested Agents Mulder and Scully's assistance in finding his missing neighbors ("Agua Mala").

title: Deputy Greer
gameEffect: Deputy Greer can ignore Activator requirements to requisition WEAPON Equipment cards, but he cannot use them for himself. He must give them to another Agent on his Team during a subsequent Requisition Phase. If his Team is attacked by an EVOLUTIONARY or PRIMORDIAL Adversary, Greer must be the first Agent to receive damage.
bio: Deputy Greer mistook Agents Mulder and Scully for looters while they were investigating the disappearance of the Shipley family in Goodland, Florida. Greer was later attacked by a mysterious sea creature that was brought to land by Hurricane Leroy.

title: Arlene, Personal Assistant
gameEffect: Place a token on this card. Discard a token to search your Bureau Deck and add any one BUREAUCRACY card to your hand. Shuffle your deck. Alternately, discard a token to negate any one card that specifically affects Skinner.
bio: As a personal assistant to A.D. Walter Skinner, Arlene routinely prevented Agents Mulder and Scully from barging into her boss's office without an appointment.

title: Arthur Dales, Retired Police Officer
gameEffect: Place a token on this card. When Dales' Team successfully investigates a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION Site, you may discard a token to select any one card from your Discard Pile and add it to your hand.
bio: In 1947, Arthur Dales was a member of the Roswell Police Department. He was assigned to protect Josh Exley, a baseball player who was actually an alien. Due to their parents' lack of imagination, Dales shares his first name with his brother, retired FBI agent Arthur Dales.

title: The Newborn Alien
gameEffect: Unless this Adversary is negated immediately, force the Team to make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If the Team fails, attach this card to an Agent. The Agent's HEALTH is reduced by 1 each time they contribute to a skill check. When the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero, remove the Agent from the game and place this card next to your X-File. The Newboard Alien may then attack any one Team at a Site for zero cost. The LRC round is skipped.
dialogue: "The virus producing an extraterrestrial biological entity that ripped away his chest as it birthed itself right here." - Mulder

title: Westward Movement
gameEffect: This card does not initiate Combat. Attach it to an Agent. As long as this card is in play, the Agent receives one point of damage every time they are not moved to a new section during their Deployment Phase. When the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero, the Agent is immediately moved to the Hospital and this card is removed from the game. The effects of this card are negated if the Agent successfully investigates a Site by themselves.
dialogue: "Crump sick. Will die if stopped same as wife. Must head west to keep alive. No roadblocks!" - Mulder's note to Scully

title: Star-Crossed Lovers
gameEffect: The LRC round is skipped. Only Agents with a BEHAVIORAL skill of 1+ may apply their CRC skills in Combat. If this Adversary's HEALTH is not reduced to zero during the first CRC round, select two Agents on the Team (your choice). The two Agents will attack each other using their CRC skills until at least one of them is reduced to zero HEALTH.
dialogue:
Lyda: "Christmas comes but once a year."
Maurice: "You're right. These two do seem pretty miserable. We need to show them just how lonely Christmas can be."

title: Demon Fetal Harvester
gameEffect: The Harvester must assign damage to female Agents first. Damage cause by this Adversary may be spilt among all female Agents on the Team. The Harvester may use SUBTERFUGE cards.
dialogue: "He meets or screens prospective women through work and then he plants as many seeds as he can. Let's just hope he hasn't been able to harvest many more of them." - Mulder

title: The Sea Creature
gameEffect: The Sea Creature is unaffected by Combat attacks. It attack for only one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round and is then discarded. If an Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero as a result of this Creature's attack, your opponent may not have more than five cards in their hand at the end of this turn.
dialogue: "It doesn't just live in water. It is water. Taking shape only when it attacks, like it did when the hurricane backed seawater into the plumbing." - Mulder

title: Bernard Oates
gameEffect: Bernard Oates deals 5 damage to an Agent (your choice) and is then removed from the game with the Site. The target Agent must go to the Hospital regardless of HEALTH, and the remaining Agents on the Team are moved to the Bureau. This Adversary is negated if your opponent gives you 6 tokens from their [RP] Pool to add to your [CP] Pool.
dialogue:
Scully: "You have control over everything that happens here. You do. It doesn't have to end like this."
Bernard Oates: "Yeah, it does."

title: Aggressive HOA
gameEffect: This Creature's LRC, CRC, and HEALTH are contingent on the number of cards in your opponent's Discard Pile. (Between 1 and 10 cards in the Discard Pile) = 3 LRC, CRC, and HEALTH, (11-20) = 4, (21-30) = 5, (31-40) = 6, (over 40) = 7. At the end of Combat, flip the top card of your Bureau Deck. If the revealed card has a [RP] cost, select one of your Agents to go to the Hospital with 3 points of damage. If the card has a [CP] or [*P] cost, shuffle this Creature back into your Bureau Deck.
dialogue: "A Tulpa. It's a Tibetan thought - form. You can give it life, but you can't control it." - Mulder

title: The Wanshang Dhole
gameEffect: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. The Wanshang Dhole will attack one Agent (your choice). The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. If the Adversary's HEALTH has not been reduced to zero at the end of Combat, place it ten cards down in your Bureau Deck. The Wanshang Dhole may use Combat cards for one [CP] less.
dialogue: "In Chinese myth, the Dhgole can be evil, capable of opening doors, stealing wives and disappearing into thin air." - Karin Berquist

title: Wilson "Pinker" Rawls
gameEffect: Any [RP] cards attached to Agents at this Site are immediately removed from the game. The cost of Combat cards played during this Combat is increased by 2 [RP] for the Investigating Player.
dialogue:
Scully: "He walks through solid objects?"
Mulder: "Changing their composition fundamentally - making steel brittle, turning lead bullets into powder."
Scully: "And flesh into carbon."

title: Ken Naciamento
gameEffect: Ken Naciamento is unaffected by Combat attacks. He will attack one Agent for one CLOSER RANGE COMBAT round and is then discarded. You may ignore Activator requirements to play this card if you have identified the MOTIVE of your opponent's X-File (or if your opponent has identified yours).
dialogue:
Phillip Padgett: "What do you want?"
Ken Naciamento: "I'm here to help you finish."
Padgett: "I can't figure out your motive."

title: Elko County Coroner
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, when a Keyword BUREAUCRACY, GOVERNMENT, or SCIENCES card is played, you may remove a token to force your opponent to discard one card from their hand at random. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue: "The former Vicky Jenkins Crump. I'm hoping you can tell me what I'm looking at 'cause this is a new one on me." - Elko County Coroner

title: Patrol Captain Van Gelder
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword BUREAUCRACY Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "We'll shut him down eat od Tuscarora - nice, clean, remote space we can own." - Patrol Captain Van Gelder

title: Dana Scully, OSS Operative
gameEffect: Attach this card to Agent Scully. At any time, you may send this Witness to join any Team that does not include Scully. Dana Scully, OSS Operative, will contribute to one skill check that the Team makes, with skills equal to Scully's starting stats. Remove this card from the game at the end of the turn.
dialogue: "Oh, you speak English, do you? Well, how'd you like to see the stars on the American flag?" - Dana Scully, OSS Operative

title: Joanne Fletcher
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. The cost of any Keyword GOVERNMENT or MOVE card played while the Agent's Team is investigating a Site is decreased by 1 [RP] or increased by 1 [CP]. Discard this card if the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
dialogue:
Joanne Fletcher: "Go tell it to that tramp of yours, that Scully, whatshername."
Mulder (as Fletcher): "Dana Scully. Special Agent Dana Scully."
Joanne Fletcher: "Special Tramp Dana Scully!"

title: General Wegman
gameEffect: At the start of your Briefing Phase, you may discard up to two cards with a [CP] cost. Add one [RP] to your pool per discarded card (regardless of the cost of the discarded card).
dialogue: "My entire career has been spent hiding the truth from the American people, destroying, in a way, that which was most precious to me." - General Wegman

title: Laura Weinsider
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. The cost of any Keyword OCCULT or OCCULT INVESTIGATION card played while the Agent's Team is investigating a Site is decreased by 1 [RP] or increased by 1 [CP]. Discard this card if the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
dialogue:
Laura Weinsider: "I keep calling it a nightmare...But how many people's nightmares come true?"
Mulder: "Not many. Certainly not in the way yours did, Mrs. Weinsider."

title: Sheila Fontaine & Holman Hardt
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword OBSERVATION Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue:
Sheila Fontaine: "Is it true? That you make the weather? The tornado in high school, snow at my wedding? Because you love me?"
Holman Hardt: "Because I love you."

title: Dr. Plant
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword MEDICAL Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "I'm going to release you. But I suggest you rethink the boxing. You're not twenty anymore." - Dr. Plant

title: Alfred Fellig
gameEffect: Play this card in your Field. When your opponent plays an Adversary, you may discard the top card from your Bureau Deck. If the card has a [RP] or [*P] cost, the Adversary is negated and Fellig is removed from the game. If the card has a [CP] cost, play proceeds as normal.
dialogue:
Scully: "Why take a picture of Death?"
Alfred Fellig: "So I can look into his face. So I can die."

title: Cassandra Spender
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. The cost of any Keyword ALIEN or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card played while the Agent's Team is investigating a Site is decreased by 1 [RP] or increased by 1 [CP]. Discard this card if the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
dialogue:
Cassandra Spender: "I know what the aliens are here for and it isn't good."
Mulder: "What are they here for?"
Cassandra: "To wipe us off the planet. They're taking over the universe."

title: Angela Villareal & Walter Suarez
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. The cost of any Keyword PRIMORDIAL or PHENOMENA card played while the Agent's Team is investigating a Site is decreased by 1 [RP] or increased by 1 [CP]. Discard this card if the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
dialogue: "Thank you, but I'm not in labor. And my is not 'Suarez'. It's Villareal. He tells people I'm his wife. Like he's so macho." - Angela Villareal

title: Pam, Time Loop Captive
gameEffect: Play this Witness to force your opponent to return to their hand a card that they just played. The cost of this card is 3 [RP] if played on "Bernard Oates" or "Bombing at Cradock Marine Bank." Remove Pam from the game at the end of the turn.
dialogue: "I have tried everything to stop him. I've hid his keys, I've drugged his coffee...I even called the police on him myself. He always gets here. He's meant to. It's you. It's you and your partner every time. If it wasn't for you, nobody would die." - Pam

title: Win Shroeder
gameEffect: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OBSERVATION 3+.
dialogue: "Just trying to be neighborly. Got to be up to code." - Win Shroeber

title: Big Mike
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "I'm Mike Raskub, by the way. Big Mike, for obvious reasons. I just live the next street over." - Big Mike

title: Karin Berquist
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. The cost of any Keyword EVOLUTIONARY or SUBTERFUGE card played while the Agent's Team is investigating a Site is decreased by 1 [RP] or increased by 1 [CP]. Discard this card if the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.
dialogue: "Karin Berquist knows more about canine behaviorisms than anybody on the planet. She's lived with wild canids and wolves in the wilderness of five different continents." - Mulder

title: Officer Jeffrey Cahn
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword SUBTERFUGE Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "I'm leaving my dart gun in the car. I'm going to live rounds from here on out. I don't care what the regulations say." - Officer Jeffrey Cahn

title: June Gurwtich
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, when a Keyword BEHAVIORAL, CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION, or SUBTERFUGE card is played, you may remove a token to force your opponent to discard one card from their hand at random. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue:
Mulder: "Who is Rawls to you?"
June Gurwitch: "A mistake. The biggest one of many."

title: Phillip Padgett
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword BEHAVIORAL Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "To really write someone, I have to be in their head. I have to know them more completely than they know themselves." - Phillip Padgett

title: Josh Exley
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "I don't want to be no famous man. Just want to be a man." - Josh Exley

title: Jimmy the Geek
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword COMPUTER Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "There's a hole in their security. I've got it all figured out." - Jimmy the Geek

title: Boone County Coroner
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "We got your gas spectrometer results. That stuff on the bones I said was bog sludge? It isn't." - Boone County Coroner

title: Dr. Solomon Merkmallen
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword SCIENCES Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "I can't explain how it is...but the two pieces have become one." - Dr. Solomon Merkmallen

title: Dr. Steven Sandoz
gameEffect: Place two tokens on this card. Once per turn, you may remove a token to discard one face-down Bluff attached to a Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site. If there are several Bluffs, the Bluff to be discarded must be chosen randomly. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.
dialogue: "Albert was the only translator who didn't dismiss me out of hand. When I showed him the original artifact, he sensed immediately its power and importance." - Dr. Sandoz

title: Rolling Hills Nuclear Power Plant, Phoenix, AZ
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
dialogue: "That thing is somewhere inside the Number Four reactor building. Now, we can let them find it and destroy it or go find it ourselves. You need proof, Fox. You're so close. Why can't you see that?" - Diana Fowley

title: Crump Trailer, Montello, NV
question: You may ask one RESULT question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Police Escort" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Doctor: "The trailer looks clean. No readily apparent vectors."
Scully: "Dogs, housewives...Whatever this thing is, it doesn't discriminate."
Doctor: "There are zoonotic pathogens which spread among species."

title: The Queen Anne, Sargasso Sea
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
dialogue:
Langly: "The SS Queen Anne which by all accounts vanished without a trace over sixty years ago."
Scully: "The Queen Anne? The British luxury liner?"
Frohike: "That's correct."
Scully: "It was torpedoed by a German U - boat."
Langly: "That's one story."

title: Atomic Gas Station, Groom Lake, NV
question: You may ask one METHOD question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Police Escort" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue: "We got the trace back on the call we received this morning. It came from a has station payphone off of Highway 375 three miles east of Groom Lake." - Scully

title: Little A'le'inn, Rachel, NV
question: You may ask one RESULT question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Police Escort" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Mulder (as Fletcher): "You're right. We should get out of the house. Go someplace with a lot of people."
Joanne Fletcher: "Someplace with a lot of people? In Rachel, Nevada?"
Mulder (as Fletcher): "What do you say?"

title: Haunted Manor, Somewhere in Maryland
question: You may ask one METHOD question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Merry Christmas" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Scully: "I see. The dark, Gothic manor, the omnipresent low fog hugging the thicket of overgrowth. Wait - is that a hound I hear baying out on the moors?"
Mulder: "No, actually that was a left cheek sneak."

title: Weinsider Residence, Hollis, VA
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
dialogue:
Scully: "Mulder, where are you? I waited forty - five minutes for you this morning."
Mulder: "Before I tell you, I'm going to ask you to keep an open mind."
Scully: "This isn't an X - File?"
Mulder: "Call it what you like. Here in Roanoke they're calling it a demon baby snatching."
Scully: "You're in Virginia?"

title: Kroner High School, Kroner, KS
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
dialogue:
Sheila Fontaine: "Are we still going to the reunion together on Friday?"
Holman Hardt: "Absolutely. Social event of the decade."
Sheila: "Hard to believe it's been twenty years since we finished high school. Where did the time go? What were those FBI people looking for?"

title: Abandoned Power Plant, Maryland
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the MOTIVE is "Security", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
dialogue:
FBI Technician: "That's the kind of levels you used to see in the 1970s. Right before the EPA got fangs."
Mulder: "From where?"
FBI Technician: "Demo site, maybe, or an old power plant."

title: Alfred Fellig's Apartment, Brooklyn, NY
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Alfred Fellig" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Scully: "I'm parked around the block."
Agent Ritter: "Fellig's asleep. I haven't seen him move in over four hours. Have a lovely evening."

title: Potomac Yard, Arlington, VA
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one METHOD question.
dialogue:
Spender: "What happened here?"
Skinner: "No one knows yet. A group of people were burned alive here. Another man's on life support. Only your mother survived."

title: The Watergate Apartments, Washington, D.C.
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one RESULT question.
dialogue:
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "The door was open. I came in."
Mulder: "Interesting company you keep."
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "No more interesting than your apparent...lingerie fetish."

title: El Rico Air Force Base, West Virginia
question: You may ask one RESULT question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Dawn of Armageddon" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue: "That's where it all begins. That's where we need to be if we want to survive it." - Mulder

title: The Breakers Condominiums, Goodland, FL
question: You may ask one METHOD question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Reggie the Cat" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Scully: "What is it that brought you out here in the first place, Mr. Dales?"
Arthur Dales: "I came down for the weather."

title: Cradock Marine Bank, Washington, D.C.
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Pam, Time Loop Captive" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue: "Silent alarm tripped thirty minutes ago. We think there's one robber, armed. Probably a handgun. Definitely no pro or he would have been long gone. A single gunshot about twenty minutes ago. Blinds are down but we think we've got a body on the floor." - Lieutenant Kraskow

title: The Falls at Arcadia, San Diego County, CA
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one MOTIVE question.
dialogue: "It would seem the code of silence that hid the sins of this community has not only survived but, in its creator, claimed a final victim. Meanwhile, the Falls at Arcadia has been named one of the top planned communities in California for the sixth year running." - Scully

title: Freighter T'ien Kou, San Pedro, CA
question: You may ask one METHOD question or one RESULT question. If you ask if the METHOD is "Subterfuge", the skill check prerequisite is 4+.
dialogue:
Scully: "Whatcha got?"
Mulder: "Two merchant marines found dead this morning in San Pedro...in the hold of their cargo ship."
Scully: "Mind if I ask the cause of death?"
Mulder: "On the crime report, it says multiple bite wounds."

title: Prison Farm, Jasper County, MS
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
dialogue:
Scully: "Should we arrest David Copperfield?"
Mulder: "Yes, we should, but not for this. Now this is Raybert Fellowes, superintendent of Road Farm Six, Mississippi Department of Corrections. One of his guards found him in his office. Not a drop of blood in the place."

title: Catholic Church, Washington, D.C.
question: You may ask one MOTIVE question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Purple Prose" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Phillip Padgett: "You came here specifically to see this painting, didn't you?"
Scully: "Yes. How did you know that?"
Padgett: "I saw you enter. The way you knew right where it was."
Scully: "I know you. You live next to somebody I work with. Why are you following me?"

title: Arthur Dales's Apartment, Washington, D.C.
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
dialogue:
Mulder: "You seriously want me to believe that Josh Exley, maybe one of the greatest ballplayers of all times, was an alien?"
Arthur Dales: "They're all aliens, Agent Mulder. All the great ones."
Mulder: "Babe Ruth was an alien?"
Dales: "Yes."
Mulder: "Joe DiMaggio?"
Dales: "Sure."

title: Monte Carlo Hotel, Las Vegas, NV
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Chance Encounter" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Mulder's Voice: "Listen, Scully, I need you on the next flight to Las Vegas."
Scully: "Las Vegas? Why?"
Mulder's Voice: "It's really important. Trust me."
Scully: "Yeah, I trust you, Mulder. It's the Three Stooges I'm not so sure about."

title: Brown Mountain, NC
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question or one METHOD question.
dialogue: "Strange multicolored lights are seen to dance above the peak of the mountain. There's been no geological explanation, no scientific credible explanation at all." - Mulder

title: American University, Washington, D.C.
question: You may ask one AFFILIATION question.
bonusEffect: If the skill check prerequisite is 5+, you may search your Bureau Deck and add "Rubbing of the Alien Artifact" to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
dialogue:
Scully: "Guess I was right about this being a police matter. Detective?"
Detective: "Can I help you?"
Scully: "Agents Mulder and Scully with the FBI. What do you have?"
Detective: "Probable weapon. Blood and hair on it. Looks like prints, too."

title: Syndicate Boy Scout
gameEffect: Play on any "Gibson Praise" card. Inflict 2X damage to an opposing Agent in the Field (your choice). X = the number of tokens currently on Gibson. Remove Gibson from the game and place this card next to your X-File. Discard this card to examine your opponent's hand or to play the "Newborn Alien" at no cost.
dialogue: "You think I can destroy you for what I know, because of what I am. You're thinking you could've destroyed me, too. And if I don't find this creature, you will." - Gibson Praise

title: A.D. Maslin
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File along with two tokens. While this card is in play, you may remove a token to force your opponent to pay 2 RP when when remove one of their Agents' game effect tokens. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional cost, their token is discarded and generates no effect. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue: "You and Agent Scully will cease all material association with the X - Files. Refusal to do so will end in immediate dismissal." - Assistant Director Maslin

title: Bozo Work
gameEffect: Play this card on a Team about to investigate a Site with BUREAUCRACY as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at that Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.
dialogue: "The sun will rise in America tomorrow regardless of whether or not we're at yet another farm investigating yet another enormous pile of doo - doo. We can be in and out in a day. Nobody has to know." - Mulder

title: Project Seafarer
gameEffect: Place this card in your opponent's Field along with two tokens. Discard a token each time your opponent successfully investigates a Site. While this card is in play, one Agent in the Field (your choice) receives one point of damage at the start of your opponent's Investigation Phase. You may not target the same Agent in two consecutive turns, unless there are no other eligible targets. Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue: "E.L.F. fields have been shown to produce biological effects in human tissue." - Scully

title: Police Escort
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent. If the Agent is the only one investigating a Site, you may discard this card to allow another Agent in the Field or in the Bureau to contribute their skills remotely to one non-Combat skill check occurring at the Site. Alternately, discard this card at the start of your Investigation Phase to prevent your opponent from playing any Adversaries at the Site.
dialogue: "We're keeping them in visual plus we're in phone contact, not to mention the strings we pulled to keep this off local TV." - Patrol Captain Van Gelder

title: Caught in a Time Warp
gameEffect: Play this card to force your opponent to return to their hand a card that they just played. X = the cost of the card.
dialogue: "You've been caught in some kind of time warp. In some kind of limbo dimension and now you've popped out the other side into 1998." - Mulder, to the crew of the Queen Anne

title: Thor's Hammer
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File along with X tokens. X = the number of Agents in your opponent's Field. Every time your opponent asks you a characteristic or an identity question about your X-File, you may remove a token to inflict one point of damage to an opposing Agent in the Field (your choice). Discard this card when the last token is removed.
dialogue: "We have our next passenger, a lady. Aim the weapon at her. Kill her if he does not answer the question." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man (translated from German)

title: Highway Impassable
gameEffect: Play this card at the start of your opponent's Deployment Phase. No Agents may be deployed to the Field. This card may not be played during your opponent's first turn. X = 3 [CP] for each opposing Agent not in the Field.
dialogue:
Morris Fletcher: "You're going to have to turn around and leave immediately."
Mulder: "Why?" It's a public highway."
Morris Fletcher: "It also borders on a U.S. Government testing ground. What's your business here?"

title: Temporal Distortion
gameEffect: Play this card to switch an Agent in your opponent's Field with an Agent in your Field. Both Agents must have the same cost. Players may use the Agent's skills buy may not remove any game effect tokens from the Agent or from any card attached to them. At the end of the Debriefing Phase, return the Agents to their original locations. If an Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero during the switch, they are sent to the owning player's Hospital.
dialogue: "Something really weird happened last night when that UFO passed over us. The man that you're with, that's not me." - Mulder (as Fletcher)

title: Perfectly Synchronized
gameEffect: Play this card at the start of your opponent's Deployment Phase. For the remainder of the turn, your opponent may not have more Agents in their Field section than you currently have in yours. Any extra Agents are sent back to the Bureau immediately (opponent's choice). X = 3 [CP] per extra Agent.
dialogue: "Morris? What are you doing?" - Joanne Fletcher

title: Government Whitewash
gameEffect: Play this card to force your opponent to remove one game effect token from every Witness and Equipment card in play. The discarded tokens generate no effect.
dialogue:
Howard Grodin: "Burn it."
Soldier: "Clear perimeter, two hundred feet! Let's go! All right, everybody, pull back!"

title: Howard Grodin
gameEffect: Play this card at the start of your opponent's Case Assignment Phase. Your opponent must pay one extra [RP] for each Site card they play this turn.
dialogue: "That's one question I haven't been able to answer. It is possible we suffered consequences from our exposure that we're not fully aware of." - Howard Grodin

title: Spatial Anomaly
gameEffect: Play on an Agent with at least one ACTIVE card attached to them. The Agent is sent to the Hospital with three damage tokens and may not leave until all tokens are removed. Any cards attached to the Agent are removed from the game. X = the number of ACTIVE cards attached to the Agent.
dialogue: "A lizard and a rock existing in the same time and space.The fact that none of us remembers seeing it is evidence that my theory is correct, sir." - Howard Grodin

title: To Be Continued...
gameEffect: At the end of your Investigation Phase, place this card on a Site to keep it in play when it should normally be discarded. Discard this card when you send a Team to investigate the Site. While this card is in play, no face-down cards may be assigned to the Site.
dialogue: "You bastard! Tell them the truth! Scully, he's not me! He's not me!" - Mulder (as Fletcher), while being dragged away by MPs

title: Higher Education
gameEffect: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: BEHAVIORAL, BUREAUCRACY, or the ability to generate one extra RES when they are in the Bureau. This card may not by played on A.D. Skinner or Section Chief Blevins. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.
dialogue: "Fox buckled down and worked his butt off. Graduated top of his class at Oxford, then top of his class at Oxford, then top of his class at the FBI Academy." - Morris Fletcher

title: False Narratives
gameEffect: Place this card in your Field along with two tokens. Once per turn, you may remove a token to double the cost of one of the following cards: "No One So Paranoid", "The Lone Gunmen", "Langly", "Frohike", or "Byers". If the opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional cost, the card is discarded. Discard this card when the last token is removed. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.
dialogue: "Look at this crap you print. Not only do you believe this horse pucky that we create, you broadcast it as well." - Mulder (as Fletcher)

title: Boo!
gameEffect: Negates any one card played against your Team during a Behavioral or Occult Investigation skill check.
dialogue: "That's not funny!" - Scully

title: Merry Christmas
gameEffect: Play this card at any time to allow an Agent to immediately swap any one Equipment or attached [RP] card with those of another Agent on the Team. This may not include TRAINING cards or cards that specifically affect the Agent.
dialogue:
Mulder: "I know we said that we weren't going to exchange gifts but...I got you a little something. Merry Christmas."
Scully: "Well, I got you a little something, too."

title: File 13
gameEffect: Play this card to examine the top five cards of your opponent's Discard Pile. Select one card and place it in your Bureau (face up). Leave "File 13" on top of the card to remind you of its effects. You may use the card when appropriate but you must pay the cost. Discard "File 13" and return the card to its owner's Discard Pile after it has been used.
dialogue:
Mulder: "Spender just round filed this case. It's unconscionable."
Scully (on the phone): "And what do you call rooting through his trash?"

title: Close Surveillance
gameEffect: During your Deployment Phase, place this card on an Agent with a cost of 4 [RP] or more. The Agent is taken out of play for the rest of the turn. While this card is in play, your opponent may not play any Adversary cards. Discard this card during your next Deployment Phase and return the Agent to the Bureau.
dialogue:
Wayne Weinsider: "I'm late for an appointment."
Mulder: "So where is our appointment? How far do we have to go? Come on, Wayne, I'll race you!"

title: Betsy Monroe
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.
dialogue: "It was no coincidence that she ran into us last night. We were taken in by her just like Wayne was - by a woman who would say anything or do anything to get what she wanted, who was even more driven than he was." - Mulder

title: Cindy Culpepper
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's COMPUTER or OBSERVATION skill check.
dialogue:
Cindy Culpepper: "Don't y'all need a warrant or a subpoena or something life that?"
Scully: "We usually just say, 'please'."

title: The Gundersons
gameEffect: Play this card after a Team fails to successfully investigate a Site. Place one token on one [CP] RESOURCE card in your section of the table that normally starts with at least one token. This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used. This may not take a card above the normal number of tokens allowed. The cost to play this card is reduced by one if Agents Mulder and/or Scully are part of the Team.
dialogue: "It's like looking in a mirror." - Mulder

title: A Big Reward
gameEffect: Play this card after you successfully negate an Adversary or one of your Team kills it in Combat. Immediately add one game effect token on one Agent on the Team that normally starts with at least one token. This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used and may exceed the normal number of tokens allowed.
dialogue: "You deserve a big reward!" - Sheila Fontaine

title: Nanotechnology
gameEffect: Play this card on Assistant Director Skinner when damage has been assigned to him. Remove all damage tokens and apply the following permanent modifiers: +1 CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and SUBTERFUGE, and -1 HEALTH. In addition, treat Skinner as a RES 2 when he is in the Field. Place this card below Skinner to remind you of its effects.
dialogue:
Mulder: "Nanotechnology. Microscopic, atom - sized machines? Machines can be stopped."
Matheson: "Your friend is already dead."

title: Dr. Kenneth Orgel
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's BUREAUCRACY or MEDICAL skill check.
dialogue:
Scully: "That's Kenneth Orgel. An advisor to a Senate subcommittee on ethics and new technology."
Skinner: "He's a scientist?"
Scully: "A physicist. Very well - known as far as physicists go."

title: Remote Control
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File and select one opposing Agent. Once per turn, when the Agent receives damage, you may pay 3 [CP] to inflict one additional point of damage to the Agent. If A.D. Skinner is the chosen Agent , or if Agent Krycek is in your Field section, damage may be inflicted for 2 [CP]. This card is negated when a HEALING card is played on the Agent.
dialogue: "You know I can push the button any time." - Krycek

title: Delaying the Inevitable
gameEffect: Play when your opponent negates one of your cards. The card remains in play until the end of the turn and is then removed from the game.
dialogue:
Alfred Fellig: "It could happen in the next minute, in the next hour, but it'll happen. It's as plain as day."
Scully: "Look, Mr. Fellig, I don't know what you're planning, but nobody here is going to die."

title: Successful Alien/Human Hybrid
gameEffect: Play this card to remove an afflicting Keyword (i.e. CANCER, INSANITY) from an Agent. The Agent is immune from all afflicting Keywords for the remainder of the game. In addition, if the removed Keyword was ABDUCTEE or SUPER SOLDIER, apply the following permanent modifiers: +1 HEALTH and the ability to add one token to your [RP] Pool every time the Agent investigates an ALIEN INVESTIGATION Site. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of its effects.
dialogue: "I believe Cassandra Spender may very well be the first successful alien/human hybrid." - Mulder

title: Tying Up Loose Ends
gameEffect: Play this card on a RESOURCE Witness in play in your section of the table. Remove the Witness from the game and add X tokens to your [CP] Pool. X = the cost of the Witness.
dialogue:
Dr. Openshaw: "They will come and question me."
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "I know. I'm sorry."

title: A Twisted Family History
gameEffect: Play this card to search your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: "A Beckoning Offer", "Influential Patron", "Successful Alien/Human Hybrid", "The Breather", or any one card whose title includes "Spender" or 'The Cigarette-Smoking Man". If you play the chosen card immediately, you may do so for half-cost (rounded up).
dialogue: "My son refused to believe that his mother had been abducted...though it had been going on for years. Even after I schemed to put him in charge of the X - Files." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

title: Skinner's Warning
gameEffect: Play on any ACTIVE RESOURCE card in your section of the table. Remove the card from the game and add its cost to your [RP] Pool. Alternately, play this card to immediately add 2X [RP] to your pool. X = the number of Keyword BONUS Sites in your Discard Pile.
dialogue: "Get up from the desk. Get up, turn the computer off, grab whatever you took or printed out and give it to me. Let's go, agents! They're coming!" - Skinner

title: Covert Operation
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File along with three tokens. When you send an opposing Agent to the Hospital, you may remove a token to immediately add 3 [CP] to your pool. Discard this card when the last token is removed. If a NEUTRAL Agent in your section of the table is equipped with the "Alien Stiletto", you may place two additional tokens on this card.
dialogue:
Jeffrey Spender: "What is it?"
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "A weapon. A man has infiltrated the group that I work with. That's to kill him."

title: Krycek to the Rescue
gameEffect: Play this card after one of your Adversaries has been negated or killed in Combat. If you have at least one NEUTRAL Agent in your Field section, you may deal 3 damage to one Agent on the Investigating Team (your choice).
dialogue: "You've never seen one before, have you? It's shocking at first. The acceptance of the idea, it's something you thought only children and fools believed in." - Krycek

title: CDC Intervention
gameEffect: Play this card after a Site has been successfully investigated. Every Agent on the Team is sent to the Hospital (undamaged). Your opponent still gets to ask you a characteristic and/or an identity question about your X-File. X = the number of Agents on the Team. Alternately, pay 4 CP to place an additional token on "Quarantine Zone".
dialogue: "You're gonna be transported to a quarantine facility." - CDC Agent

title: Marita Infected
gameEffect: Play this card on Marita Covarrubias when she is in the Hospital. Any afflicted Keywords (i.e., ABDUCTEE, CANCER) and damage tokens are immediately removed. Apply the following permanent modifiers: +1 ALIEN INVESTIGATION, +1 RES, and -1 HEALTH. Place this card below Marita to remind you of its effects.
dialogue:
Mulder: "What have they done to you?"
Marita Covarrubias: "Tests. Terrible, terrible tests. I was infected with the alien virus - the black oil."

title: Limited Disclosure
gameEffect: Play this card after your opponent asks you a characteristic question about your X-File. Unless the Investigating Team makes a successful BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check, your opponent cannot guess the identity of your X-File.
dialogue: "I remember looking over a gun barrel at you once before, Agent Mulder. You couldn't pull the trigger then. What makes you think you can do it now?" - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

title: Dawn of Armageddon
gameEffect: Play this card after your opponent discards a token to trigger its game effect. The discarded token generates no effect.
dialogue: "This isn't supposed to be. Get back. Back! Back!" - First Elder, as armed alien rebels surround the Syndicate

title: Jeffrey Spender Shot in FBI Office
gameEffect: If a Team which includes Agent Spender fails any skill check in the Field, Agent Spender is immediately removed from the game. Your opponent may search their Bureau Deck, add "The Breather", to their hand, and shuffle their deck.
dialogue:
Jeffrey Spender: "I know more than enough about your past. Enough to hate you."
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "Your mother was right. I came here hoping otherwise. Hoping that my son might live to honor me...like Bill Mulder's son."

title: Hurricane Leroy
gameEffect: Place this card in your opponent's Field. Your opponent may not play any new Site cards until all Sites currently in play have been investigated and resolved.
dialogue:
Deputy: "Unless your car has wings, there's no getting through on this road."
Scully: "What about the airport? Is there an alternate route?"
Deputy: "Airport? No, not tonight. This hurricane's really bearing down on us."

title: Bombing at Cradock Marine Bank
gameEffect: When your opponent asks you a characteristic question about your X-File and receives a 'no' answer, place this card in your Field along with four tokens. Remove a token during each of your opponent's Debriefing Phases. As long as this card is in play, your opponent can only investigate Sites that allow them to ask the same characteristic question that they just asked. Discard this card when the last token is removed or when your opponent obtains a 'yes' answer.
dialogue: "You're saying this day repeats over and over again." - Mulder

title: One of Those Days
gameEffect: Play this card on an Agent during your opponent's Deployment Phase. For the remainder of the turn, the Agent contributes negatively (e.g., a +1 becomes a -1) to any non-Combat skill checks that they are part of.
dialogue: "My waterbed sprung a leak and shorted out my alarm clock. My cell phone got wet and crapped out on me and the check I wrote my landlord to cover the damages is going to bounce if I don't deposit my pay." - Mulder

title: Temporarily Out of Service
gameEffect: Play this card at the start of your opponent's Briefing Phase. For the remainder of the turn, your opponent may not draw any cards from their Discard Pile. Cards that should go to the Discard Pile are removed from the game instead.
dialogue: "I'll use the ATM machine. I don't want to tempt fate." - Mulder

title: Welcome to the Falls
gameEffect: During the Briefing Phase, place one token on every Witness and Equipment in your section of the table that normally starts with at least one token. This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used. This may not take a card above the normal number of tokens allowed.
dialogue: "You must be the Petries. Hi. Welcome. Welcome to the Falls." - Pat Verlander

title: Rob and Laura Petrie
gameEffect: Play this card in your Field. Place a token on this card every time one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with BEHAVIORAL, BUREAUCRACY, or OBSERVATION as a prerequisite. Discard a token to draw the top card of your Bureau Deck and add it to your hand.
dialogue:
Mulder: "I'm Rob and this is my lovely wife, Laura."
Pat Verlander: "Rob and Laura Petrie."
Scully: "We pronounce it 'Pee - trie', actually."

title: Gene Gogolak
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.
dialogue: "Rules are rules. It may not sound like anything - a simply basketball hoop. But from there, it's just a few short steps to spinning daisy reflectors and a bass boat in the driveway." - Gene Gogolak

title: Deep Cover
gameEffect: Play this card on a Team about to investigate a Site with CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at the Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.
dialogue: "Have you noticed how everybody around here is obsessed with the neighborhood rules and the CC&Rs? You what know? You fit in really well here." - Mulder

title: Dr. Ian Detweiler
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's BEHAVIORAL or SCIENCES skill check.
dialogue: "You went to China looking for that animal and you may have tracked it as you claim, but the rest is far from the truth. You found the Wanshang Dhole, but you never caught it. It caught you." - Mulder

title: Posthumous Present
gameEffect: Play this card on a Witness attached to an Agent. If the Witness is discarded or removed from the game at any time, discard this card and add X tokens to your [RP] Pool. X = the cost of the Witness.
dialogue: "She seems to have made a connection to you." - Scully, about Karin Berquist

title: Cryptic Message
gameEffect: Play this card any time after your opponent's Briefing Phase to select one card from your Discard Pile and place it in your hand.
dialogue: "You think he's trying to tell us something?" - Mulder, about the inscription left by Pinker Rawls

title: Purple Prose
gameEffect: Change any Keyword to any other Keyword on one of your cards in play. This effect lasts until the end of the turn. This does not affect cards played by your opponent prior to this card being played.
dialogue: "By their nature words are imprecise and layered with meaning. The signs of things, not the things themselves. It's difficult to say who's in charge." - Phillip Padgett

title: Final Act of Destruction
gameEffect: Negate one PRIMORDIAL Adversary. In addition, if the Team makes a BEHAVIORAL 6+ skill check, they may ask either one MOTIVE question or one RESULT question.
dialogue: "And yet, reflected back upon him, at last he could see his own ending. And in this final act of destruction, a chance to give what he could not receive." - Phillip Padgett

title: Dual Nature
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File. While this card is in play, add one extra point to your [CP] Pool every time you sell a Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE card, up to a maximum of two points per turn.
dialogue:
Josh Exley: "Man, you ain't dreaming. This is what I really look like. This is the real me."
Arthur Dales: "Ex? It's really you under there, Ex?"

title: Alien Bounty Klansman
gameEffect: Apply a -2 modifier to an opponent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.
dialogue: "Show me your true face so you can die with dignity. As your executioner, I show you my true face before I kill you." - 1947 Alien Bounty Hunter

title: Touching Base
gameEffect: Play to immediately add 2 [RP] to your pool for each game effect token that you discard from Equipment or Witness cards under your control (up to a maximum of 3 tokens). The discarded tokens generate no effect.
dialogue:
Mulder: "You concentrate on hitting that little ball. The rest of the world just fades away. All your everyday, nagging concerns. The ticking of your biological clock...How you threw away a promising career in medicine to hunt alien with a crackpot, albeit brilliant, partner..."
Scully: "Shut up, Mulder. I'm playing baseball."

title: High-Stakes Game
gameEffect: Play this card on a Team about to investigate a Site with SUBTERFUGE as a prerequisite. Discard all cards assigned as Bluff cards at the Site. X = the number of Bluffs at the Site.
dialogue:
Grant Ellis: "Looks like it's just you and me."
Byers: "Another two hundred."
Grant Eliis: "I'll see your two hundred...and raise you one...thousand."

title: Chance Encounter
gameEffect: Play this card to place one Agent's game effect token on another Agent on their Team (except for [RP]s that get replaced during the Briefing Phase). This token is usable in the same way that starting tokens can be used. This may not take a card above the normal number of tokens allowed. This card may not be used twice on the same Agents.
dialogue:
Morris Fletcher: "We could have been stardust."
Scully: "Maybe next time."

title: Unusual Behavior
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent along with two tokens during your opponent's Deployment Phase. Remove a token during each of their Debriefing Phases. While this card is in play, the Agent may only contribute their skills to either MONO or MULTI Sites (your choice). The choice must be made when this card is played and cannot be changed later. Discard this card when the last token is removed or when a HEALING card is played on the Agent.
dialogue: "She's not drunk. Look at this. That was made by an injector gun." - Susanne Modeski

title: Farewell Susanne
gameEffect: Play this card on a Team that has "Susanne Modeski" attached to one of its Agents to gain one of the following effects: negate one [CP] card played against the Team, or apply a +2 modifier to one skill check made by the Team.
dialogue:
Susanne Modeski: "Come with me."
Byers: "You'll be safer without me."
Modeski: "It doesn't make a difference. I told you, I'm going public."

title: Perfunctory Dance
gameEffect: Place this card on an Agent in the Bureau section during the Briefing Phase. If the Agent is part of a Team that successfully investigates a Site (using one of the Agent's skills), you may guess the identity of your opponent's X-File without incurring a penalty question. Discard this card at the end of the turn.
dialogue: "Every time I bring tou a case we go through this perfunctory dance. You tell me I'm not being scientifically rigorous, that I'm off my nut, and then in the end who out to be right? Like 98.9% of the time?" - Mulder

title: Brown Mountain Lights
gameEffect: Remove one game effect token from one of your Agents in the Field (except for [RP]s that get replaced during the Briefing Phase) to negate any one card played by your opponent during their Investigation Phase. The discarded token generates no effect.
dialogue:
Mulder: "They found your skeleton not two hundred yards from here."
Wallace Schiff: "It's fake. They put it there."
Mulder: "Who put it there?"
Schiff: "You know who."
Mulder: "The Brown Mountain lights."

title: Dreamy Goo
gameEffect: Place this card next to your X-File. While this card is in play, add one extra point to your [CP] Pool every time you sell a Keyword BEHAVIORAL or OBSERVATION card, up to a maximum of two points per turn.
dialogue: "How long were we underground? Hours? Half a day? How come our bodies don't show any effects of being burned by the digestive fluids? We were covered in hydrochloric acid. Yet look at our skin. Nothing. Scully...We never escaped. We're still trapped underground." - Mulder

title: Aural Dissonance
gameEffect: Play this card on Agent Mulder after he has been in the section of the table designated The Gulag. Apply the following modifiers: +1 OBSERVATION, +1 SUBTERFUGE, and -1 HEALTH. Place three tokens on this card. Remove a token to examine any face-down card (except your opponent's X-File). This card is free if Mulder is equipped with the "Rubbing of the Alien Artifact".
dialogue:
Mulder: "There's someone else on this case - you're not telling me."
Skinner: "What the hell's he talking about?"
Mulder: "I hear it, in my head."

title: Abnormal Brain Activity
gameEffect: During your opponent's Investigation Phase, play this card on an Agent afflicted with the Keyword INSANITY to inflict X damage to another Agent on their Team (your choice). X = the afflicted Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill. Alternately, pay 3 [CP] to send the afflicted Agent to the Hospital immediately (undamaged).
dialogue: "He's extremely violent. With what we've given him he should be in a barbiturate coma, but there's brain activity in areas we've never seen before." - Dr. Harriman

title: Hidden Camera
gameEffect: Shuffle this card face-up in your opponent's Bureau Deck. When this card reaches the top of their deck, your opponent must show you their entire hand. Place this card in your Discard Pile. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.
dialogue: "Dr. Sandoz, I don't know if this is a secure line." - Scully

title: Access Restricted
gameEffect: Remove a game effect token from a NEUTRAL Agent in your Field section (except for [RP]s that get replaced during the Briefing Phase) to prevent one Agent (your choice) from contributing their skills to any skill checks occurring at this Site. The discarded token generates no effect. This card is free if the token is removed from Agent Spender or Fowley.
dialogue:
Mulder: "Diana, let us in here."
Fowley: "I can't. This facility has been sealed off by the NRC."

title: Past and Present Collide
gameEffect: If there is a copy of this Site in either player's Discard Pile, apply a -2 modifier to any skill checks that the Team makes at this Site (except Combat).
dialogue: "This ship's been caught in something called the Devil's Triangle. It's some kind of time warp - a rift in space." - Mulder

title: Captain Robert McDonough
gameEffect: Play to negate one Keyword SUBTERFUGE card.
dialogue: "You ain't going nowhere, Mibby. You and me have had our asses officially disappeared. Looks like we're up fudge creek." - Captain Robert McDonough

title: Scream of Terror
gameEffect: If your opponent negates a Keyword OCCULT card while investigating this Site, each Agent on the Team without a BEHAVIORAL or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill receives one point of damage.
dialogue:
Scully: "Please, I'm a little on edge. Don't come any closer. My name is Special Agent Dana Scully. I can show you my I.D."
Lyda: "My goodness, I thought you were a ghost."

title: Dead Ringers
gameEffect: Every Agent on the Team who is also in your Field section is immediately sent to the Hospital (undamaged).
dialogue:
Scully: "You know what's weird? She's wearing my outfit."
Mulder: "How embarrassing."
Scully: "Yeah, well, you know what? He's wearing yours."
Mulder: "Scully..."
Scully: "That's us."

title: Priority Caseload
gameEffect: Play this card to negate a BONUS Site's game effect.
dialogue: "Okay, Deputy. We're going to put this right into our priority caseload." - Spender

title: Daryl Mootz, The Rain King
gameEffect: If your opponent negates a Keyword EVOLUTIONARY card while investigating this Site, each Agent on the Team without a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or MEDICAL skill receives one point of damage.
dialogue: "My Irish Aunt Olive has more Cherokee in her than Daryl Mootz. I mean, look at him, Mulder. Does that look like a man who can control the weather?" - Scully

title: Political Indiscretion
gameEffect: If your opponent negates a Keyword GOVERNMENT card while investigating this Site, each Agent on the Team without a BUREAUCRACY or COMPUTER skill receives one point of damage.
dialogue:
Senator Richard Matheson: "If you pursue this, Fox, they will kill you."
Mulder: "Not before I expose you and your role in this."

title: Pursued by Death
gameEffect: Any Agent who receives damage during Combat is sent to the Hospital immediately and may not leave until fully healed.
dialogue:
Alfred Fellig: "I missed my chance. You're very lucky, you know that?"
Scully: "You mean lucky like the others? You want me to believe that I'm about to die?"
Fellig: "I just want to take the picture."

title: Alien Imposter
gameEffect: If your opponent negates a Keyword ALIEN card while investigating this Site, each Agent on the Team without a ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill receives one point of damage.
dialogue: "My colleagues had become old men, blind to the fact that the faceless rebels already held the upper hand...that they'd used their powers of disguise to infiltrate our group." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

title: Busted
gameEffect: Play to prevent your opponent from drawing any cards from their Bureau Deck or Discard Pile while investigating this Site. This card is free if played on a Keyword BONUS Site.
dialogue: "Assistant Director. I'll assume you came down to apprehend these agents for unauthorized entry into my office. I'll make sure it's duly noted in the report of their dismissal." - Jeffrey Spender

title: The Most Painful Sacrifice
gameEffect: Play this card to search your Bureau Deck. Select up to three Witness cards and remove them from the game. Shuffle your deck. Add 2x [CP] to your pool. X = the number of Witnesses removed from your deck.
dialogue:
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "The group had agreed to the most painful sacrifices. Sacrifices that no one else would ever be asked to make."
Mulder: "You gave them your children! You gave them your wife! You sent them away like they were things."

title: Dougie the Looter
gameEffect: Look at the top ten cards of your opponent's Discard Pile. You may steal any one [CP] card and play it immediately for half-cost (rounded up), Activator requirements permitting. Return the card to your opponent's Discard Pile after playing it.
dialogue:
Dougie: "I'll put it back."
Mulder: "Yeah. Everything in your pockets, too."

title: George Vincent
gameEffect: Play this card to prevent your opponent from playing any Keyword HEALING cards while investigating this Site. The effects of any HEALING cards already in play are ignored until the Site is discarded.
dialogue:
George Vincent: "If he's your partner, he should have listened to you."
Scully: "You can't just leave him there!"
Vincent: "I'm not letting him in."
Scully: "He'll die."

title: Timmy the Mole
gameEffect: Play this card to inflict X damage to an opposing Agent (your choice). X = the difference between the Investigating Team's skill level and the Site prerequisite.
dialogue:
Timmy: "You really screwed things up, Jimmy. We had big plans for you."
Jimmy the Geek: "Big plans? Political assassination! I was right. I was right about the whole thing!"
Timmy: "Every good plan needs a patsy."

title: Faint of Heart
gameEffect: Play to negate one Keyword SCIENCES card.
dialogue:
Scully: "You're absolutely sure you wanna be here for this?"
Langly: "Oh, yeah. I'm cool. Let's just find out what killed him."

title: Technical Difficulties
gameEffect: The modifiers of every Equipment card attached to Agents at this Site are now changed to a negative (e.g., a +1 becomes a -1). If an Equipment card has an effect separate from a modifier, this card cancels that effect for this turn.
dialogue: "I don't know what they did the screen for this thing." - Mulder

title: Altered Reality
gameEffect: Play this card to add X to the Site Prerequisite. X = the total number of game effect tokens on every Agent on the Team (except for [RP]s that get replaced during the Briefing Phase.
dialogue: "This doesn't make sense." - Mulder

title: Pseudoscientists
gameEffect: If your opponent negates a Keyword PRIMORDIAL card while investigating this Site, each Agent on the Team without an OBSERVATION or SCIENCES skill receives one point of damage.
dialogue: "Do you know Dr. Sandoz believes this writing was from aliens? These are trivial men. They have no patience for the scientific process. They're happy to ready their names in the tabloids. Pseudoscientists. Beyond embarrassment." - Dr. Barnes

title: Fowley, The Double Agent
gameEffect: Every NEUTRAL Agent on the Team contributes negatively to any skill checks (except Combat) occurring at this Site (e.g., a +1 becomes a -1). If Agent Fowley is in your Field section, you may remove one of her game effect tokens to play this card at no cost. The discarded token generates no effect.
dialogue: "It's Diana Fowley calling for him. I received a call from Agent Mulder this evening. He was in a particular state of distress. I don't know why, but I'm staying here until I find out." - Diana Fowley

title: Restoration Software
gameEffect: Place this card in your Bureau. When a [RP] card should be placed in your Discard Pile, you may place it under this card instead along with two tokens. Remove a token during each of your Briefing Phases. When the last token is removed, add the card to your hand and discard this Equipment.
dialogue: "While this process will be tedious and ongoing, what I've already recovered will allow Agent Scully and I to begin work on the X - Files immediately." - Mulder

title: Large-Bore Needle
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a MEDICAL skill of 1+. Discard this card to heal up to three damage done to another Agent on the Team. This may prevent an Agent from going to a Hospital.
dialogue: "She will insert a long, large - bore needle into your inner ear, hopefully relieving the pressure." - Mulder

title: The Lone Gunmen Mobile
gameEffect: Once per turn, you may discard one of the following cards from your hand: "No One So Paranoid", "The Lone Gunmen", "Langly", "Frohike", or "Byers", to move one of the attached Agent to the location of your choice immediately (unless the Agent is in the Hospital). This effect may not be used once an Adversary has forced Combat until after the Combat is resolved.
dialogue: "Wait from me downstairs." - Scully

title: Fletcher's ID
gameEffect: Once per turn, you may remove one [CP] from your Conspiracy Pool to reduce the cost of one [RP] card by one. If this card is attached to a NEUTRAL Agent, you may remove it from the game during your opponent's turn to immediately add 5 [CP] to your Conspiracy Pool.
dialogue: Your identification, sir." - Security Guard

title: Penny and Dime
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with an EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill of 2+. Discard this card to add any one card from your Discard Pile to your hand.
dialogue:
Gas Station Attendant: "That'll be $1.89. You get eleven cents change."
Mulder (as Morris): "Keep it."
Gas Station Attendant: "Wow. Maybe I'll close early."

title: Handcuffs
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill of 2+. Discard this card to prevent an opponent from dealing any damage during one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round.
dialogue:
Scully: "Do you know what would really be fun?"
Morris Fletcher (as Mulder): "What? Oh, yeah! Me first?"
Scully: "You first."

title: A Book of Christmas Stories
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill of 2+. Discard this card to return one OCCULT card played by your opponent to the bottom of their Bureau Deck..
dialogue: "I was young young and beautiful once, just like your partner. Whoo! Look at us. Maurice was so handsome. He didn't have a gut." - Lyda

title: FBI Security Cameras
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with an OBSERVATION skill of 1+. Discard this card to look at the first five cards of your Bureau Deck and place them back in any order.
dialogue:
Mulder: "There you are."
Skinner: "That's him. Right there."
Scully: "Wait a second. Back up. It can't be. That's Kenneth Orgel."

title: Classified Personnel File
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a BUREAUCRACY skill of 1+. Discard this card to return one GOVERNMENT card played by your opponent to the bottom of their Bureau Deck..
dialogue:
Mulder: "That's C.G.B. Spender and my father."
Scully: "It was taken in 1973. I traced the connection to something they worked on together for twenty - five years at the State Department. A highly classified project."

title: The Alien Fetus
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with an ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill of 2+. Discard this card to return one ALIEN card played by your opponent to the bottom of their Bureau Deck..
dialogue: "You see, the alien fetus would give us the alien genome...the DNA with which we could make a human hybrid. A new race, Agent Mulder." - The Cigarette - Smoking Man

title: Reggie the Cat
gameEffect: Discard Reggie the Cat to search your Bureau Deck for any one Keyword HEALING or NEGATE card. Add the card to your hand and shuffle your deck.
dialogue: "I saw the Shipley's cat, which had been saved, which had been in the washing machine." - Mulder

title: Video Camera
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill of 2+. Discard this card to return one EVOLUTIONARY card played by your opponent to the bottom of their Bureau Deck..
dialogue: "6:01 PM. February 24. Agents Scully and Mulder in the former head of David and Nancy Kline who disappeared without a trace last July. The Klines were the third such couple to disappear since this neighborhood was built in 1991." - Scully

title: Tranquilizer Gun
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a LONG RANGE COMBAT skill of 2+. Discard this card to prevent an opponent from dealing any damage during one round of LONG RANGE COMBAT. Agents equipped with the Tranquilizer Gun are immune to the Wanshang Dhole's attacks.
dialogue: "Come on, dog. Come on." - Karin Berquist

title: Milagro Charm
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a BEHAVIORAL skill of 2+. Discard this card to return one PRIMORDIAL card played by your opponent to the bottom of their Bureau Deck..
dialogue: "It's called a 'milagro'. That's the Spanish word for 'miracle'. It's worn as a lucky charm." - Scully

title: Spy Glasses
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a COMPUTER skill of 1+. Discard this card to allow the Agent to add their skills to one non-Combat skill check that is occurring in another location.
dialogue: "Oh, man! Don't freak. I'm on it. AE - 135...Bingo! 442 J - stroke A - 135 air conditioning units for B - 2 bombers. Talk air conditioners." - Langly

title: Speech Simulator
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+. Discard this card to use your [CP] Pool to pay for any one [RP] card while the Agent is part of a Team investigating a Site.
dialogue:
Langly: "What if she calls him back?"
Byers: "I trapped her cell number. If she calls him, it rings here."
Frohike: "She's gonna kick our ass."

title: Synthesized Antidote
gameEffect: Attach this card to an Agent with a SCIENCES skill of 1+ The attached Agent's Keywords may not be modified nor can any afflicting Keywords be added by your opponent. Any Keywords afflicted prior to this card being played are negated. This card is free if "Susanne Modeski" is in play in your section of the table.
dialogue: "This will counteract the anoetic effect." - Susanne Modeski

title: Rubbing of the Alien Artifact
gameEffect: Once per turn, you may examine one card at random in your opponent's hand. While this card is in play, subtract one from the attached Agent's HEALTH. If this card is attached to Mulder, he is afflicted with the Keyword INSANITY instead.
dialogue:
Scully: "Do you have a fever?"
Mulder: "No. This is going to sound weird, but I think it's that thing."
Scully: "You're not kidding. It's just a piece of paper."

title: Soul Snatching
gameEffect: Play this card on any OCCULT Adversary that has just reduced a combatant's HEALTH to zero. Add X to the Adversary's LRC or CRC skill for the next of Combat. X = the wounded combatant's permanent HEALTH.
dialogue:
Wayne Weinsider: "Why'd you go and do that, Laura? You've got to know that I love you. And I just wish...you could've been the one."
Laura Weinsider: "Let me go, Wayne."

title: Restrike
gameEffect: Play this card on any ALIEN Adversary. Force your opponent to discard a Witness card in play in their section of the table (your choice) to add 1 to the Adversary's LRC or CRC skill for one round of Combat.
dialogue:
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "The rebels have struck."
Second Elder: "Where?"
The Cigarette - Smoking Man: "In Virginia. During one of our medical procedures. They killed the project doctors. Burned them."

title: Carbonized Flesh
gameEffect: Play this card on any EVOLUTIONARY Adversary. For each Agent sent to the Hospital during this Combat, your opponent must discard one RESOURCE in play in their section of the table (your choice). If your opponent has no RESOURCE card in play, they must discard one card at random from their hand instead.
dialogue:
Scully: "Oh my God."
Mulder: Don't recognize him from his driver's license, do you?"

title: Hoodwink
gameEffect: Play this card on any GOVERNMENT Adversary. Add 1 to the Adversary's LRC and CRC skills for every Keyword GOVERNMENT card discarded from your hand.
dialogue:
Frohike: "What the hell was she injected with?!"
Susanne Modeski: "It's derivative of A - H gas. A - H, Anoetic Histamine, my latest creation."

title: Fake Out
gameEffect: Play this card on an Agent who has just received damage. The Agent heals one damage for every game effect token you discard from one of your cards in play (except for [RP]s that get replaced during the Briefing Phase). The discarded tokens generate no effect. X = the number of discarded tokens.
dialogue:
Susanne Modeski: "Big surprise, huh? Since you programmed my friend to kill me."
Ellis: "No, Susanne, it wasn't my idea."
Modeski: "You knew about it. You gave it to them. The A - H. If I hadn't thought to check Langly, if I hadn't given him the antidote."

title: Deadly Misstep
gameEffect: Play this card on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary. Add X to the Adversary's LRC or CRC skill for the next round of Combat. X = the number of Keyword PRIMORDIAL cards in your Discard Pile, up to a maximum of 5.
dialogue: "Wild mushrooms, Mulder. They were growing there. I stepped on one, and it gave off spores. Several varieties of mushrooms are known for their hallucinogenic properties. If we inhaled it..." - Scully

title: Eleventh Hour Rescue
gameEffect: Play this card on one of your Agents who has just received damage. The Agent is immediately moved to the Hospital (regardless of HEALTH) along with another Agent on the Team (your choice). The accompanying Agent does not receive any damage. The Adversary is discarded.
dialogue: "Hurry up! Get him out! Get him out! Keep digging! Sh's down here! Pull her up. Get her out!" - Skinner, to the rescue party as they recover Mulder and Scully
